# vkd3d-compiler (win-x64)

This directory contains pre-built binaries and licensing information for `vkd3d-compiler`.

* Upstream Source: https://dl.winehq.org/vkd3d/source/vkd3d-1.2.tar.xz (WineHQ vkd3d project)
* License: GNU Lesser General Public License version 2.1 (LGPL-2.1-or-later). See `LICENSE.LGPL-2.1.txt` and `LICENSE.txt`.
* Build Target: Windows x86_64 (MinGW-w64 static runtime)
* Usage: Distributed alongside MercuryManager.Server for shader compilation without requiring external system dependencies on Windows.
